# Item 188 — release checks

**Stage: `prepared_needs_deposit`.** Technical checks and package files are complete locally. No deposit or approval is implied.

| Gate | Evidence/status | Required before release |
|---|---|---|
| Actual data and documentation | **Verified local**: 22 aggregate observations, README, dictionary, attribution and checksums | Retain the package and source locators; recheck if the source changes. |
| Source association and UIST relationship | **Verified public**: chapter DOI and file match; source author Lina Milosevska has UIST affiliation in the publication/Crossref | Confirm this derived compilation is within the accepted collection scope. |
| Reuse basis | **Verified public**: chapter-specific CC BY 4.0; separate book licence noted | The responsible depositor confirms source attribution, compiler contribution and applicable package licence. |
| Compiler / depositor | **Unknown**: no responsible named human compiler/depositor recorded | Identify responsible person and authority; distinguish from original study authors. |
| Source-author endorsement | **Unknown**: not obtained or claimed | Do not claim endorsement. Consultation is not silently added as a requirement of CC BY. |
| Deposit agreement acceptance | **Unknown** | Complete the normal DSpace deposit terms for the actual authorised submitting account. |
| Applicable policy and collection scope | **Depositor confirmation needed** | Use the current simplified repository policies; verify the chosen collection accepts this described output. |
| Access decision | **Institutional decision required**: open/no embargo proposed | Confirm file access separately from reuse rights; do not publish participant-level data. |
| Identifier / collection / issue date | **Unknown**: unassigned | Choose actual research-data collection; assign the separate identifier and actual release date through normal deposit. |
| Preservation / ingest | **Unknown** for this un-ingested package; local checksums verified | Apply adopted ingest/preservation procedure; record required actual checks rather than software capability. |
| Production validation | **Unknown**: not deposited | After authorised release, verify landing URL, intended anonymous access, correct files/checksums, UI/REST/OAI/JSON-LD and publication link. |

No raw respondent data, full questionnaire, per-question denominators or original-author release authority are inferred. This package is a transparently derived, partial aggregate compilation. Technical verification does not certify comprehensive privacy/legal/ethics clearance.
